Users can now publish Weave tools for use within their Figma organization. Internally published Weave tools will appear in the Tools tab in Figma alongside Weave tools built by Figma and the Figma Community. Internal publishing is only available on Organization and Enterprise plans.
Learn more about Weave tools in Figma.

Connect Google Drive to the Figma agent and Make to bring your existing file context into Figma, and create new Drive files without leaving your file. Use the Google Drive connector to summarize research insights, reference real data, or pull in assets to edit on the canvas.
Connectors are now available on all Figma plans, including Starter. Add Google Drive and other connectors from the plus menu in the prompt box when you collaborate with Figma agents.
Learn more in the help center

Editing your generative plugins and shaders now creates a new version, preserving previous versions of your tools for you to revisit and restore. Each new version gets an agent-generated description to form a change log and provide a view of which version is currently published. Rolling out this week.

All of the video and image models available through Figma Weave are now accessible in your AI agent via the Figma MCP. With a Figma Weave account connected to your Figma account, you can generate videos and images with models like Seedance, Kling, and Nano Banana while chatting with your external agent. Videos and images generated with models from Weave will consume Weave credits.
Learn more about what you can do with Figma Weave via the Figma MCP

Admins on Enterprise plans have more ways to manage paid AI credit usage, support team collaboration, and automate everyday workflows. Here’s what’s new:
Set paid AI credit defaults.
Assign default per-user access at the organization and billing group levels for your paid AI credits. These defaults will apply to new and existing users who don’t have custom access.
Learn more here.
Manage AI credit access through SCIM.
Use your identity provider to configure paid AI credit access and limits for SCIM-managed users.
Learn more here.
Control external plan creation.
Prevent team members from creating new Starter or Professional plans with company email addresses through the external plan creation feature.
Learn more here.
Automate team, folder, and file management.
Use new admin REST APIs to set up and manage teams, folders, and files.
Learn more here.
Rolling out to Enterprise plans in the coming days.

Today, we launched new ways to build and collaborate with code, capture and share context, and build with real data and content. Here’s everything we shared at Config India 2026:
Code layers:
Create interactive, code-backed prototypes on the canvas by converting a design frame, importing a GitHub repo, capturing your website with
the Figma Chrome extension
, or prompting from scratch. Rolling out now in open beta. Creating and editing within a code layer will be free on paid plans through November 4.
Learn more.
Specs:
Bring written intent, visual exploration, and technical details together for your team and your agents with Figma Specs, a native home for context. Rolling out now in open beta on all plans.
Payload in Figma:
Make now natively scaffolds a Payload backend, giving your app a CMS, database, media, APIs, auth, and an admin panel, turning a prototype into a production app. Figma hosts it all, so your content and data live in the same place as the designs that shape them. Rolling out across all plans.
Code sources
. Import code from GitHub repositories or npm packages to help the agent build and edit components and code layers that reflect your real design systems. Rolling out now in closed beta.
Guidelines.
Add guidelines to your published design libraries to help the agent follow your design system’s established patterns and avoid anti-patterns. Rolling out now in open beta.
Centralized design systems:
Bundle design libraries, code libraries, and guidelines into a single design system, so maintenance is easier for authors and adherence is easier for everyone. Preview only.
Figma MCP:
Faster performance and support for more Figma products let you do more from your favorite AI tools. Create code layers, edit specs, or generate images on the Figma canvas. Now with support for 20 new partners. Available now.
Explore everything we announced at Config India in our recap blog post.
Watch the keynote
